description: MAIN-PARA's DFHPF3 back-navigation arm taken with a POPULATED ORIGIN - the echo at app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:131-133 - derived from :123-135 with :273-284 and :306-314 reached from it. This is case04's PAIRED SIBLING and the two differ in ONE inbound field, so the pair proves both sides of the :129 IF rather than duplicating one side: case04 arrives with CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM blank and takes the 'COMEN01C' fallback at :130, and this case arrives with a real program name and takes the ELSE at :131-133. It is the REENTER half of gate G38, as case04 is, and it is the third of the three XCTL shapes this program has - case02 covers the hard-coded 'COSGN00C' of the no-commarea guard at :107-109, case04 the conditional main-menu fallback of the PF3 arm, and this case the echoed origin of that same arm - and none of the three transmits a screen, which is why all three leave the mapset and the map unnamed. IN SOURCE ORDER. :101-102 SET ERR-FLG-OFF and USR-MODIFIED-NO, restating the declared initial values of WS-ERR-FLG and WS-USR-MODIFIED at :43-50; :104-105 MOVE SPACES TO WS-MESSAGE and to ERRMSGO OF COBIL0AO; :107 finds EIBCALEN non-zero - 218 - so the cold-start arm is not taken; :111 MOVE DFHCOMMAREA(1:EIBCALEN) TO CARDDEMO-COMMAREA copies the travelled area over the working-storage one; :112 finds NOT CDEMO-PGM-REENTER false, because CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT arrives 1 and the 88 CDEMO-PGM-REENTER of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:31 is therefore true, so control takes the ELSE at :123; :124 performs RECEIVE-BILLPAY-SCREEN; :125 evaluates EIBAID; :128 matches WHEN DFHPF3; :129 tests CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM against SPACES OR LOW-VALUES and finds it NEITHER, so the 'COMEN01C' fallback at :130 is NOT taken and the ELSE at :131-133 runs instead; :132-133 MOVE CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM TO CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM - THE ECHO, and the arm this case exists to pin; :135 performs RETURN-TO-PREV-SCREEN. That paragraph then runs its four statements and transfers: :275-277 IF CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM = LOW-VALUES OR SPACES substitutes 'COSGN00C', and HERE THAT GUARD IS A NO-OP - the echo at :132-133 has just populated the field, so the substitution does not fire and 'COSGN00C' appears nowhere in this case, which is stated explicitly so that no reader mistakes the guard for having fired; :278 MOVE WS-TRANID TO CDEMO-FROM-TRANID, which becomes 'CB00' from the literal at :38; :279 MOVE WS-PGMNAME TO CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, which becomes 'COBIL00C' from the literal at :37; :280 MOVE ZEROS TO CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT, so the context leaves as 0 and the screen this transfers to paints itself rather than validating a map nobody typed into; :281-284 EXEC CICS XCTL PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM) COMMAREA(CARDDEMO-COMMAREA), the program's only XCTL site. The EXEC CICS RETURN TRANSID at :146-149 is NOT reached - an XCTL transfers control and never returns - which is why the termination is XCTL and not RETURN_TRANSID. THE DOUBLE ASSIGNMENT, AND ITS ORDER (AAP rule R7, practice B5). This is the whole difficulty of the case, and it is asserted on BOTH fields rather than on nextProgram alone. CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is read at :129, copied out at :132-133, and then OVERWRITTEN at :279 - all three within one invocation, and in that order. So the field that ARRIVES 'COTRN00C' LEAVES as 'COBIL00C', while CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM, which arrived as eight spaces, LEAVES carrying the 'COTRN00C' that CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM used to hold. BEFORE: CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM 'COTRN00C', CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM eight spaces. AFTER: CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM 'COBIL00C', CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM 'COTRN00C'. A translation that stamped :279 before echoing at :132-133 would send the operator back into COBIL00C itself - an F3 that never leaves - and it would still satisfy any expectation that pinned nextProgram alone, which is precisely why both post-states are declared here. The order is not incidental: :278 and :279 together are how the screen this transfers to knows who called it, and are what makes ITS own PF3 come back to CB00. THE ORDERED DISPATCH (gate G30). The EVALUATE EIBAID at :125-142 has exactly four arms and they are, in this source order: DFHENTER performs PROCESS-ENTER-KEY at :126-127; DFHPF3 navigates back at :128-135; DFHPF4 clears the screen at :136-137; and WHEN OTHER at :138-141 sets WS-ERR-FLG, moves CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY and sends. The first match wins and WHEN OTHER is LAST, so DFHPF3 is reached here only because DFHENTER did not match first - had the order been inverted this same request would have paid a bill instead of leaving the screen. There is no PF7, PF8, PF12, CLEAR or PA1 arm in this program and none is invented; app/bms/COBIL00.bms:135 advertises exactly the three named keys with INITIAL='ENTER=Continue  F3=Back  F4=Clear'. DFHAID is IBM-supplied and ABSENT from this repository (AAP risk R-D), so the mnemonic resolves through common.CicsAid, which reproduces DFHPF3 as the EBCDIC digit three, 0xF3, at CicsAid.java:323. COBIL00C tests EIBAID INLINE, because it copies NEITHER CSSTRPFY NOR CSSETATY - its COPY list at :63-85 is COCOM01Y, COBIL00, COTTL01Y, CSDAT01Y, CSMSG01Y, CVACT01Y, CVACT03Y, CVTRA05Y, DFHAID and DFHBMSCA - so common.PfKeyResolver.isPf3 stands in only for that identical byte equality, and none of CSSTRPFY's PF13-PF24 folding is asserted for a program that does not perform it. WHAT THE RECEIVE DOES AND DOES NOT DO. :124 runs on EVERY re-entry, before the AID is examined, and :308-314 is EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP('COBIL0A') MAPSET('COBIL00') INTO(COBIL0AI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) RESP2(WS-REAS-CD). WS-RESP-CD and WS-REAS-CD are declared at :46-47, named on this command, and then TESTED BY NOTHING on any path - unlike the seven file paragraphs from :343 onwards, six of which evaluate them and display them at :366, :397, :430, :461, :490 and :541 (ENDBR-TRANSACT-FILE at :501-505 names neither). That absence is preserved rather than repaired: no RESP branch is invented for it, forcedOutcomes declares none, and this case therefore asserts no error path the COBOL has no code for. Because this arm sends no map, the ten xxxI items the receive filled - TRNNAMEI X(4), TITLE01I X(40), CURDATEI X(8), PGMNAMEI X(8), TITLE02I X(40), CURTIMEI X(8), ACTIDINI X(11), CURBALI X(14), CONFIRMI X(1) and ERRMSGI X(78) of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY - sit on no compared channel, so mapFields declares none rather than declaring values this path cannot observe. WHAT DOES NOT HAPPEN. This arm performs no SEND-BILLPAY-SCREEN, so POPULATE-HEADER-INFO at :319-338 never runs: no TITLE01O, TITLE02O, TRNNAMEO, PGMNAMEO, CURDATEO or CURTIMEO is set, sends is empty rather than carrying a screen, and nextMapset and nextMap are absent because naming COBIL00 and COBIL0A here would tell a stateless client to paint the bill-payment screen it has just left. No MOVE -1 TO xxxL runs on this arm, so no cursor is positioned and cursorField is absent. No dataset is touched - PROCESS-ENTER-KEY is the only caller of READ-ACCTDAT-FILE (:177, :184), READ-CXACAIX-FILE (:211), WRITE-TRANSACT-FILE (:233) and UPDATE-ACCTDAT-FILE (:235), and it is not performed - so inputs, expectedWrites, expectedFinalState and expectedDatasets are all empty BY DERIVATION rather than by omission, and the empty expectedWrites is the positive assertion that F3 abandons the conversation without posting anything. normalisations is empty because no fixture is seeded, so the cardxref 36-to-50 FILLER pad has nothing to apply to. expectedMessages is empty: the program's only DISPLAY statements are the six inside those file paragraphs, none of which is reached, and it sends no screen, so no line reaches any channel. THERE IS NO MONETARY FIELD ON THIS PATH - the program's single COMPUTE, ACCT-CURR-BAL = ACCT-CURR-BAL - TRAN-AMT at :234, and the MOVE ACCT-CURR-BAL TO TRAN-AMT at :224 are both inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY - so no BigDecimal, no scale and no RoundingMode.DOWN is asserted here, which is stated rather than left as a silent absence. Nor is there a highlight to assert: COBIL00C copies neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY and DFHRED appears nowhere in its 572 lines, so no red-plus-asterisk expectation exists anywhere in this directory. The program contains no GO TO and no CALL 'CEE3ABD', and this screen paginates nothing, so nothing is asserted for those either; expectedReturnCode is 0 because RETURN-CODE is never assigned anywhere in the program. THE COMMAREA, FIELD BY FIELD (gates G37 and G40, AAP rule R6). EIBCALEN is 218 - the 160 bytes app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy declares (FROM-TRANID X(04) + FROM-PROGRAM X(08) + TO-TRANID X(04) + TO-PROGRAM X(08) + USER-ID X(08) + USER-TYPE X(01) + PGM-CONTEXT 9(01) = 34, plus CUST-ID 9(09) + three X(25) names = 84, plus ACCT-ID 9(11) + ACCT-STATUS X(01) = 12, plus CARD-NUM 9(16) = 16, plus LAST-MAP X(7) + LAST-MAPSET X(7) = 14) plus the 58 bytes of the CDEMO-CB00-INFO group COBIL00C.cbl:64-72 appends in place inside the same 01 (TRNID-FIRST 16, TRNID-LAST 16, PAGE-NUM 8, NEXT-PAGE-FLG 1, TRN-SEL-FLG 1, TRN-SELECTED 16). That extension stays a SEPARATE member and is never folded into the sixteen shared carriers; this arm reads and writes none of it, which is why no CDEMO-CB00- item appears on the request, and why none could appear in navigation at all - the compared navigation image is the shared 160 bytes and nothing else. Every width above is taken mechanically from the copybook rather than from prose (practice B11). Of the sixteen shared carriers this arm writes exactly four - CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM at :132-133, CDEMO-FROM-TRANID at :278, CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM at :279 and CDEMO-PGM-CONTEXT at :280 - the same four as case04, differing only in the value the first of them receives and in where that value came from. The other twelve - CDEMO-TO-TRANID, CDEMO-USER-ID, CDEMO-USER-TYPE, CDEMO-CUST-ID, CDEMO-CUST-FNAME, CDEMO-CUST-MNAME, CDEMO-CUST-LNAME, CDEMO-ACCT-ID, CDEMO-ACCT-STATUS, CDEMO-CARD-NUM, CDEMO-LAST-MAP and CDEMO-LAST-MAPSET - are untouched and travel back at their INBOUND values, which are spaces at the declared width for every X span and zeros at the declared width for every 9 span; all twelve are declared here at those values explicitly rather than silently zeroed or quietly omitted. All sixteen travel in the payload and none is held anywhere else: no server-side forward, no HTTP redirect, no request dispatch and no session affinity, so there is no server-side session state to keep. THE DISCRIMINATOR, AND WHY THE ORIGIN IS 'COTRN00C'. The inbound CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM is 'COTRN00C' - eight characters at the X(08) width app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy:22 declares - so the outbound nextProgram is 'COTRN00C' and NOT 'COMEN01C'. Had it been 'COMEN01C' the entire outbound image would be byte-identical to case04's, the pair would prove nothing about which arm fired, and case04's own reasoning - that 'COMEN01C' can only have come from :130, because :132-133 would have echoed the origin instead - would collapse. BE PRECISE ABOUT WHAT IS AND IS NOT CLAIMED HERE. Searching every file in app/cbl for 'CB00' or 'COBIL00C' returns no hit outside COBIL00C itself, so COMEN01C is at present the ONLY program that transfers to it: app/cpy/COMEN02Y.cpy declares option 10 as 'Bill Payment' with program 'COBIL00C' and user type 'U', and COMEN01C.cbl:148 moves its own WS-PGMNAME into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM before the XCTL at :153. 'COTRN00C' is chosen instead for four reasons, and it is not an arbitrary name. FIRST, THE CSD MAKES IT REAL: app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:257 DEFINEs PROGRAM(COTRN00C) in GROUP(CARDDEMO) - the same group that holds PROGRAM(COBIL00C) at :196 - and :419-420 DEFINEs TRANSACTION(CT00) against it with STATUS(ENABLED), exactly as :337-338 DEFINEs TRANSACTION(CB00) against COBIL00C, so the value is an installed eight-character program name CICS can be asked to transfer control to rather than a fabricated one. SECOND, COTRN00C is the transaction-list program and it uses the IDENTICAL stamp-then-transfer idiom this field exists for: COTRN00C.cbl:190 MOVEs its own WS-PGMNAME - 'COTRN00C', declared at :36 - into CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM, and :193 then XCTLs PROGRAM(CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM), which is exactly the shape that leaves a populated origin behind for a PF3 to echo. THIRD, COBIL00C was written to be entered from a transaction-selection list: its CDEMO-CB00-INFO extension at :64-72 is a field-for-field mirror of COTRN00C's CDEMO-CT00-INFO at :62-70 - TRNID-FIRST X(16), TRNID-LAST X(16), PAGE-NUM 9(08), NEXT-PAGE-FLG X(01) VALUE 'N', TRN-SEL-FLG X(01), TRN-SELECTED X(16) - and :116-119 reads CDEMO-CB00-TRN-SELECTED and moves it into ACTIDINI on first entry, which only a selection screen upstream would have filled. FOURTH, AND DECISIVELY FOR PARITY, :129 tests the field against SPACES and LOW-VALUES and against NOTHING ELSE - it validates no name against any list, any CSD or any table - and :275-277 then transfers to whatever CDEMO-TO-PROGRAM holds, so ANY non-blank eight bytes takes the ELSE and is echoed unexamined. That indiscriminate echo IS the behaviour being pinned, and pinning it with a real installed program name keeps the case realistic without overstating what the COBOL actually checks. DETERMINISM (practice B7). The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:32, the instant this program's version footer carries at :571 and the same instant every other case in this directory pins. It is UNUSED on this path: POPULATE-HEADER-INFO never runs, and GET-CURRENT-TIMESTAMP at :249-267, whose EXEC CICS ASKTIME sits at :251-253, is reached only from :230 inside PROCESS-ENTER-KEY, so no compared image depends on it. It is pinned all the same, so that a translation which wrongly painted a header here would produce a checkable value rather than a wall-clock one, and so that nothing in this directory is ever a captured now. US-ASCII is named explicitly rather than left to a platform default, which for a nine-fixture ASCII corpus and a twelve-dataset EBCDIC one is the difference between a comparison and a coincidence. UNIT KIND. CONTROLLER_POJO, and it has to be, for the same reason case04 is. The arm this case pins is MAIN-PARA's, and the migration puts MAIN-PARA in BillPaymentController: the EVALUATE EIBAID, the :129 test and the :131-133 echo are BillPaymentController.reentry :756-766, and :275-284 - the no-op guard, the three stamps and the transfer that sets nextProgram - is returnToPrevScreen :827-844 of that same class. BillPaymentService owns PROCESS-ENTER-KEY from :154, CLEAR-CURRENT-SCREEN at :552-555 and the invalid-key arm, has no EIBAID branch of any kind, and records at BillPaymentService.java:1788 in terms that the DFHPF3 arm's transfer of control is navigation and is the controller's. A SERVICE-kind declaration would be dispatched to processEnterKey, could never reach :123-135, and could never diff to zero. CONTROLLER_POJO is also the kind ParityCase requires a screenRequest and an expectedResponse for, which is exactly what this case is made of, since an XCTL arm writes no dataset and its whole observable behaviour is the response; and it means the handler constructed through its own constructor and called as a plain Java object: no HTTP, no MockMvc, no TestRestTemplate, no servlet container, no JobLauncher and no application context anywhere in the path, which is what gate G51 asks for. GATES. G15 as one of the twenty, G18 the diff-count-of-zero gate, G30 the ordered dispatch, G37 no server-side session state, G38 the REENTER side, G40 the XCTL-to-nextProgram projection - here the echoed origin rather than a literal - and G51 the plain-object invocation. NOT APPLICABLE AND DELIBERATELY NOT INVENTED: the CSSETATY DFHRED-plus-asterisk highlight, because neither CSSETATY nor CSSTRPFY is copied and DFHRED appears nowhere in the program; G32, no GO TO; G35, no CALL 'CEE3ABD'; G39, no pagination; and G16, G19, G21, G23, G24, G28, G45 and G47, because this arm performs no I/O and no arithmetic. PROVENANCE. Every value above is STATICALLY DERIVED - read out of app/cbl/COBIL00C.cbl:123-135, :273-284 and :306-314 and cross-checked against the 160-byte layout and PICTURE clauses of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, the WS-PGMNAME and WS-TRANID literals at :37-38, the CDEMO-CB00-INFO declaration at :64-72, the xxxI PICTURE clauses of app/cpy-bms/COBIL00.CPY, the DFHMDF definitions and the key legend of app/bms/COBIL00.bms, and the CB00-to-COBIL00C and CT00-to-COTRN00C bindings at app/csd/CARDDEMO.CSD:337-338 and :419-420 - and it WAS NOT CAPTURED FROM A LIVE COBOL EXECUTION, not one byte of it, because such a capture is empirically impossible in this environment: no z/OS or CICS runtime, an indexed file handler the available compiler reports as disabled, no Language Environment CEE services, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR absent from the repository (AAP 0.7.6 documents eight verified blockers; 0.9.11 records the substitution as risk R-A, escalated for explicit confirmation rather than absorbed).
